reviews.title: A Good card, but Drivers need work.
reviews.comment: The physical build of the card is most excellent. I am very pleased and it is also thinner than a lot of other cards today.  This card runs a little bit warm at times, but is otherwise decent. I have no trouble with it working with systems geared primarily for Nvidia aor radeon, but the performance under heavy use still needs work. They are releasing drivers so very regularly, which even often come with firmware updates, and that is something no one else does save for the highest end cards. Video clarity is most excellent and the card continue to perform for regular video and general transcoding. It's not thaty great for gaming atm. I use my system primarily for video work and a virtual world service called second Life.. it handles the latter with timmidity, and required me to do a lot of tweaking. The Tdr settings need adjusting (look this up folks.. Nvidia had the problem about 10 years ago). Each driver update seems to help not only performance, but also compatabilty issues as well. the AV1 codec processing has been broken.. Don't do it.  So far.. everything else works. I like the card a lot and we just couldn't afford the ridiculous prices the other makers are charging.. The cost of this card is better than ok, but the drivers definitely need work. I am over all rather pleased, and will be patient for now with developments. I have also been looking up various registry tweaks for better GPU,  CPU and RAM  management. They so far seem to have helped immensely. but do look up the Tdr (Timeout Detection and Recovery) settings on the net.
